verdict.rationale: Intercom, Fin's vendor platform, documents an official MCP server that lets external AI agents and tools such as ChatGPT and Claude securely access and interact with Intercom data, and a probe confirms the first-party MCP guide exists. Because this is a vendor-run server rather than Fin merely acting as an MCP client, the axis applies and the core story is delivered. missing for 10: details of the exposed tools, auth/setup flow and whether Fin-specific capabilities are exposed, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Learn how to use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable AI agents to securely access and interact with your Intercom data whenever helpful.
MCP is a protocol that enables AI tools and applications to securely access and interact with your Intercom data whenever helpful.
Securely share Intercom conversation data with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Glean
